title: Phoenix Zoo
description: Animals photographed at the Phoenix Zoo in Arizona.

photos.title: Tiger
photos.alt: A tiger lying on grass with its head raised, eyes half closed, facing the camera
photos.description: A tiger at rest beside a leaning branch, its gaze narrowed and steady.

photos.title: Giraffes
photos.alt: Three giraffes around a pole-mounted basket feeder, two of them reaching up to eat hay
photos.description: Two giraffes feed from a hanging basket while the tallest looks away across the yard.

photos.title: Elephant
photos.alt: An elephant's head and shoulder in profile, trunk curled under and hay scattered on its back
photos.description: Wrinkled grey skin fills the frame, a small twig hanging beside the curled trunk.

photos.title: Pelicans
photos.alt: Six white pelicans standing on a floating platform of planks and driftwood over blue water
photos.description: A group of pelicans rests together, orange feet planted on the edge of the float.

photos.title: Flamingo
photos.alt: A pale pink flamingo facing the camera with its head bowed so the bill runs down its neck
photos.description: Seen head-on, the bird folds into an almost perfect symmetry.

photos.title: Jaguar
photos.alt: A jaguar in three-quarter profile with its mouth open, standing between a weathered trunk and a post
photos.description: A jaguar bares its teeth between two upright timbers, its spotted coat in sharp detail.

photos.title: Pond garden
photos.alt: A tall branching succulent beside a still pond, with a grassy island, pale dead branches and palms
photos.description: A quiet corner of the zoo grounds, the pond holding the reflection of the sky.

photos.title: Tortoise
photos.alt: A large tortoise with its neck raised, looking toward the camera over its domed shell
photos.description: The ridges of the shell rise behind a head held up and alert.

photos.title: Egret
photos.alt: A white egret with wispy plumes standing among green foliage
photos.description: Soft plumes hang from the bird's back as it perches in bright sun.

photos.title: Eagle
photos.alt: An eagle's head and shoulders in black and white profile against a textured rock wall
photos.description: Every feather edge stands out in monochrome, the hooked bill turned to the left.

photos.title: Zebra
photos.alt: A zebra with its head lowered, grazing on bare ground beside a boulder in dappled light
photos.description: Narrow stripes broken up by patches of shade as the zebra feeds.

photos.title: Tortoise in water
photos.alt: A tortoise resting its head at the surface of shallow water scattered with small floating leaves
photos.description: A close view of a tortoise at rest in the shallows, its scaly foreleg and shell just beyond.

photos.title: Alligator
photos.alt: An alligator's broad head coated in green duckweed, one eye just above the water
photos.description: Only the snout, eye and ridged back break the carpet of duckweed.
